internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: ASBU is an ambitious, research-oriented, public university established in 2013. It is located in Ulus, an authentic and historical centre in the heart of Ankara. It offers undergraduate and graduate education under five faculties: Political Sciences, Social Sciences and Humanities, Foreign Languages, Theology, and Law.
